summary: Rwanda punches well above its weight in healthcare quality. King Faisal Hospital Kigali is JCI-accredited, the same international certification held by the top hospitals in the United States and Western Europe. 12 verified providers in Kigali covering travel medicine and diaspora-vetted medical care.

providers.name: King Faisal Hospital Kigali
providers.description: King Faisal Hospital Kigali is JCI-accredited: the Joint Commission International certification, the same standard held by the top hospitals in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Western Europe. This is not a marketing claim. It is independently verified international certification. Rwanda's most advanced medical facility, used by diplomats, UN staff, NGO personnel, and the Rwandan government. Full specialist coverage including cardiac surgery, oncology, and neurology. Accepts major international insurance including BUPA, Cigna, and AXA. 24-hour emergency with ICU.
